branches.source_phrase_ar: أهجد البعير ألقى جرانه بالأرض (maqayis)؛ أهجد البعير إذا ألقى جرانه بالأرض (sihah)؛ أهجد البعير إذا ألقى جرانه على الأرض (tahdhib)؛ أهجد البعير ألقى جرانه على الأرض متحريا للهجود (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, devenin boyun altındaki göğüs bölümünü yere koyması konusunda birleşir. Bu hareketin durulup dinlenme yönelimiyle açıklanması, eylemin fiziksel çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أهجد البعير إذا ألقى جرانه على الأرض
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس نوم الإنسان ولا صلاة الليل ولا تنويم الرجل

root_profile.summary: Kök, bir yerde durulup uyuma ekseninden uykuyu bırakıp özellikle gece namazına kalkmaya, başkasının uyku durumunu değiştiren veya saptayan kullanımlara ve devenin boyun altındaki göğsünü yere koymasına uzanan çok dallı bir anlam yapısı taşır.

text.arabic_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةًۭ لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًۭا مَّحْمُودًۭا

baseline.text: Gecenin bir kısmında, sana ek bir ibadet olarak onunla gece namazı kıl. Umulur ki Rabbin seni övgüye değer bir makama yükseltir.

findings.text: Geceleyin isteyerek uyanıp durmak, hareketsizlikten dikkatli ayakta oluşa geçişi bedende çalıştırır ve övgüye değer bir makama yükseltilme umudunun provası olur.

activation_trace.role: Night and its darkness supply the dormant temporal field in which the wake-and-rise relay begins.
Sleep and stillness name the bodily state that tahajjud deliberately crosses.
Awakening or putting to sleep makes tahajjud a controlled reversal between opposed states.
Rousing the still or sleeping supplies the divine-scale counterpart to the worshipper's waking.
Embodied rising and standing make maqam an achieved capacity to stand, not only a destination.

changed_reading.after: Night waking rehearses in a small bodily register the Lord's greater act of raising the addressee into a capacity to stand.
changed_reading.before: Perform an extra night devotion and later receive an honorific place.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus ayah embeds a wake-and-rise relay: night supplies dormancy, tahajjud crosses the sleep/wake boundary, divine ba'th rouses what was still, and maqam resolves the sequence as standing.

activation_trace.role: A freely given increase makes nafilah both an extra act and a surplus gift available for formation.
Repair, nurture, and completion assign the Lord the formative work rather than making elevation an automatic wage.
The split root's increase and elevation image adds an exploratory upward-growth layer to Lordly formation.
A place or duration of standing gives the formative process a stable realized form.
Being found praiseworthy after experience makes محمود the tested quality of the resulting station.

changed_reading.after: A surplus that is itself gift becomes material through which the Lord gradually forms and establishes a tested, praiseworthy stance.
changed_reading.before: A voluntary surplus earns a superior reward.

baseline_models.mechanism: Nafilah is surplus gift as well as surplus act; under the Lord's completing care, that excess becomes formative material that grows into a station found praiseworthy after testing.

activation_trace.role: Sending and directing an envoy activates a commissioned movement rather than only resurrection or elevation.
Standing over an affair in care and responsibility lets maqam function as an office to be maintained.
Praise opposed to blame qualifies how that commissioned responsibility is carried.

changed_reading.after: Alongside elevation, the Lord may dispatch the addressee into a praiseworthy standing responsibility.
changed_reading.before: The Lord will only elevate or resurrect the addressee to a praised rank.

baseline_models.mechanism: The dispatch branch of ba'th can govern the destination phrase: the Lord may direct the addressee into a maqam understood as maintained responsibility, yielding a commissioned office alongside the elevation reading.

activation_trace.role: The awakening branch locates the focus action inside the night's hidden sleep/wake reversal.
Rising and standing in prayer make established worship the opening action of the temporal sequence.
The entry of night darkness supplies the deepening phase within which tahajjud occurs.
Dawn breaking out of night supplies the visible emergence that follows hidden vigil.
Presence with witnessing turns the dawn endpoint into an observed result.
The place or duration of standing anchors the witnessed emergence back in maqam.

changed_reading.after: The station is the disclosed, witnessed form of a standing first cultivated in the hidden interior of night.
changed_reading.before: The night act and the praised station are separated as deed and later reward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah moves from established prayer through entering night to dawn recitation that is witnessed; 17:79 inserts wakeful surplus inside that arc. The praised maqam therefore reads as emergence from hidden nocturnal formation into witnessed standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered darkness, dawn, and witnessing sequence; I infer that hidden vigil ripens into witnessed standing. A live alternative is that witnessing remains confined to dawn recitation and does not characterize maqam.
structural_cues: 17:78 closes with مشهودا and 17:79 closes with مقاما محمودا, adjacent passive result descriptions across the night-to-dawn boundary.

activation_trace.role: Care, maintenance, and authority make maqam a responsibility that can remain operative through movement.
Movement into an interior supplies the first threshold over which the mandate must hold.
Complete soundness and stability make truth the invariant quality of both transitions.
Passage to the outside supplies the opposite threshold without dissolving the stable stance.
Capacity and delegated authority give the stance an operative public function.
Aid that makes manifest supplies the support by which the mandate remains effective.

changed_reading.after: Maqam can be a stable, supported mandate whose truth persists through entry, exit, and changing circumstances.
changed_reading.before: Maqam is a fixed place reached after being raised.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah pairs truthful entry and exit with requested supporting authority. This makes maqam less like a fixed pedestal and more like a stable mandate that preserves truthful form while moving across thresholds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired thresholds, stable truth, and supporting authority; I infer that maqam names a portable public capacity. A live alternative is a literal future station followed by an independent prayer for worldly transitions.
structural_cues: 17:80 immediately follows maqam with balanced causative entry/exit commands and then a request for supporting authority.

activation_trace.role: Awakening supplies the receptive bodily posture in which the referenced recitation is engaged.
Repeated reading and recitation provide the nearest explicit discourse candidate for به.
The renewed recitation image on the far side of the focus brackets the vigil with Qur'anic engagement.
Healing and recovery supply one possible formative effect of the recited revelation.
Tender mercy makes the healing effect relational rather than mechanically produced.
Increase and growth show that the same exposure can amplify an existing orientation.
General diminishment supplies the adverse pole of the revelation's posture-dependent effect.

changed_reading.after: Tahajjud is plausibly wakeful exposure to recited revelation, which forms a praiseworthy stance only through receptive engagement.
changed_reading.before: Tahajjud is an unspecified extra nocturnal exercise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Qur'an recitation before the focus and Qur'an as healing or loss-producing exposure after it activate به as vigil with the recited revelation. The night act becomes a receptive encounter whose effect depends on the hearer's posture, not an automatic technique.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation on both sides and differential effects after the focus; I infer a Qur'anic antecedent and a formative exposure. A live alternative is that به refers more narrowly to the night portion or prescribed prayer.
structural_cues: Explicit Qur'an references in 17:78 and 17:82 bracket the unresolved pronominal instrument به in 17:79.

activation_trace.role: A freely given increase lets nafilah register gift as well as additional performance.
Nurture and completion keep the resulting station under the Lord's formative agency.
Going away supplies the live possibility that the revelatory means of vigil could be removed.
Divine communication identifies what the addressee possesses only by prior bestowal.
Tender mercy supplies the stated exception that preserves the revelatory means.
Benefaction and gift make the large favor the enabling surplus beneath the worshipper's surplus.

changed_reading.after: The extra act is enabled by an already-extra gift that can only be preserved by mercy, so the praised station remains bestowed rather than claimable.
changed_reading.before: The addressee contributes extra worship and thereby accrues a claim to elevation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The possibility that revelation could be taken away, followed by its preservation as mercy and great favor, places the focus nafilah inside a prior economy of gift. The surplus practice cannot function as a self-owned merit that compels the station.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contingency, mercy, and gift; I infer that the practice's surplus depends on a prior divine surplus and cannot purchase its outcome. A live alternative is that the favor language concerns revelation alone without revising nafilah.
structural_cues: The sequence moves from extra-for-you in 17:79 to removable revelation in 17:86 and mercy/favor upon you in 17:87.

activation_trace.role: Being found praiseworthy after experience makes praise a tested quality rather than a raw vote count.
Turning something through varied forms supplies repeated presentation and testing before refusal.
Refusal and withholding acceptance separate actual reception from intrinsic praiseworthiness.
Numerical abundance makes the rejecting audience explicitly a majority.
Covering a benefit characterizes rejection as concealment of gift rather than disproof of worth.

changed_reading.after: A praised station is a tested worthy stance that can remain محمود precisely while the numerical majority refuses it.
changed_reading.before: A praised station is chiefly a rank recognized and applauded by people.

context_deltas.mechanism: Even after the discourse is turned through every kind of example, the majority refuses and covers the gift. محمود therefore cannot be reduced to present majority acclaim; it is praiseworthiness that survives adverse reception and testing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tested discourse and majority rejection; I infer that محمود is not indexed to current public applause. A live alternative is that the praise belongs to a later or different audience rather than directly to divine evaluation.
structural_cues: 17:88 asserts failed collective imitation, while 17:89 immediately reports majority refusal despite varied examples.

activation_trace.role: Sending and directing an envoy provides the focus ayah's latent commission branch.
Standing over an affair as care and responsibility gives the dispatched envoy a maqam-shaped office.
Climbing by an ascent supplies the spectacular elevation demanded by the audience and rejected as the messenger's self-proof.
The exact contextual recurrence explicitly applies dispatch to God's sending of a human messenger.
The visibly embodied human supplies the kind of agent whom the contextual ba'th dispatches.
Messenger and message specify the functional office produced by that dispatch.

changed_reading.after: يبعثك also points outward: the Lord dispatches an embodied messenger into a praiseworthy standing office, unlike the demanded spectacle of self-ascent.
changed_reading.before: يبعثك points only upward, toward a rank demonstrated by extraordinary elevation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audience demands a spectacular self-ascent, but the reply insists on human messengership; then the same ba'th root asks whether God dispatched a human messenger. This strongly activates dispatch in يبعثك while preserving elevation as a coexisting reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a self-ascent demand and an exact ba'th recurrence governing human messengership; I infer that dispatch is active in 17:79 and that maqam can be mission office. The materially live alternative is future or eschatological raising, which this delta does not cancel.
structural_cues: 17:93 contrasts demanded ascent with the reply بشرًا رسولًا; 17:94 then repeats ب ع ث in أبعث الله بشرًا رسولًا.

activation_trace.role: Night darkness makes the formative act largely hidden from ordinary human witnesses.
Being found praiseworthy after experience requires a witness competent to assess the resulting station.
Standing to an affair until sufficiency makes divine attestation fully adequate without majority assent.
Presence with witnessing supplies the explicit validating relation at the window's close.
Knowledge of report and inner reality makes the witness competent to assess hidden formation.
Insight of the heart adds inward discernment to outward witnessing.

changed_reading.after: The station's praiseworthiness can be established by the sufficient witness who knows both the hidden practice and the public commission.
changed_reading.before: The station becomes محمود when an audience recognizes it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window ends with God as sufficient witness who knows the interior and sees. That endpoint locates the validation of the hidden night act and the محمود station in adequate, informed attestation rather than in hostile public recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden night, tested praise, and a sufficient informed witness; I infer that divine attestation validates the station. A live alternative is that 17:96 settles only the messenger dispute and that other agents still supply the praise in 17:79.
structural_cues: Witness language frames the focus window: مشهودا in 17:78, محمودا in 17:79, and شهيدا in 17:96.

remaining_uncertainties: Future or eschatological elevation and present missional dispatch both remain live; the context activates the latter without disambiguating the former.
The antecedent of به is strongly cued as Qur'an by the bracket but is not grammatically exclusive of the night portion or prayer.
The عسى and extra-night outliers are root-image resonances only and should not control translation.
The non-dominant ر ب و mapping adds growth and elevation to ربك, but that layer remains exploratory beside the dominant nurture-and-completion branch.
strongest_changes: The sleep-wake and rousing-standing branches turn the verse into a rehearsal of divine raising rather than a simple deed-reward exchange.
The exact ب ع ث recurrence in 17:94 with a human messenger strongly activates dispatch into a praiseworthy office alongside elevation.
Truthful entry/exit and supporting authority make maqam a stable mobile mandate rather than only a fixed rank.
Majority refusal followed by sufficient divine witness separates محمود from popularity and locates praise in tested, informed attestation.
Bracketing Qur'an references make به plausibly revelatory exposure, while removable revelation and preserving favor prevent the extra act from becoming self-owned merit.
summary.what_was_special: The window repeatedly converts apparently static nouns into processes: hidden waking becomes witnessed standing, surplus becomes Lordly formation, maqam becomes maintained commission, and praise persists through rejection because its witness is sufficient and informed.

activation_trace.role: Intensifying night darkness echoes the earlier الليل and carries its density into the expectation hinge.
Hope for milk to return after cessation supplies a concrete depletion-to-renewal contour for the expectation.
Rousing what was still gives the exploratory return contour an explicit focus-ayah endpoint.

changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, عسى becomes a hinge where intensified darkness and depleted flow turn toward hoped-for renewed arousal.
changed_reading.before: عسى merely lowers certainty before a future raising.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عسى is syntactically an expectation auxiliary, while the cited branches are concrete root images of darkening night and hoped-for renewed milk. It remains anchored in the exact root beside الليل and يبعثك, but downstream prose should present it only as a lexical resonance, never as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: Night as a bounded dark interval supplies the temporal material from which a surplus portion can be taken.
The specialized image of extra nights after a counted set makes nafilah resonate as surplus time, not only surplus action.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the night itself is parsed as surplus temporal material, a remainder carved out and offered as wakeful practice.
changed_reading.before: Nafilah labels only the devotional act as extra.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the branch names specialized extra lunar nights, not the grammatical function of نافلة here. It remains worth carrying because الليل and نافلة occur in one compact construction, but downstream prose should qualify it as a calendrical-material analogy rather than an asserted legal or lexical sense.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Voluntary waking rehearses the movement from stillness to raised station.** `ه ج د:B001/B003` is sleep/stillness and waking, `ن ف ل:B001/B005` extra gift and extra nights, `ب ع ث:B001` rouses, `ق و م:B006` station, and `ح م د:B003/B004` praiseworthy fullness. Night practice moves from sleep through extra action toward future raising. I infer repeated self-rousing forms readiness for divinely granted station. The promised مقام reads as the enlarged counterpart of nocturnal rising.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:107–109 shows recitation itself rousing bodies into a low station. The later prostration made nocturnal self-rousing here part of a wider bodily response to revelation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Voluntary waking rehearses being raised into station.** Lexical evidence: `ه ج د B003` (causing sleep or waking) in `فَتَهَجَّدْ`, `ن ف ل B001` (the extra voluntary gift) in `نَافِلَةً`, `ب ع ث B001` (rousing a still thing into motion) in `يَبْعَثَكَ`, `ق و م B006` (standing-place or station) in `مَقَامًا`, and `ح م د B003` (the praiseworthy one of many good traits) in `مَّحْمُودًا`. Structural cue: 17:78 moves from settled night to witnessed dawn; this ayah inserts voluntary arousal within that night, while 17:80 asks for sound movement through entry and exit. Assigned role: extra waking breaks stillness by choice, and divine raising carries that trained transition into a stable station. Abductive move: `عَسَىٰ` prevents a guaranteed causal equation; I infer a rehearsal relation rather than earned automaticity. Reading change: night vigil is an embodied practice of leaving stillness for attentive standing, aligned with hope for a raised praiseworthy مقام.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:80 supplied the nearest analogue: truthful entry and exit turn the night's voluntary departure from stillness into practice for movement that retains integrity.

words.gloss_range: resumptive and coordinating connector that carries the prior prayer command into a distinct night-vigil directive
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes 17:79 feel attached to the prayer command before it, not like a devotional aside. It resumes the sequence while giving the night vigil its own unit, and its one-letter form makes the boundary quick: continuation is heard before the selected night portion is named. A circumstantial feel may remain, but the local grammar keeps resumption and coordination in control.

topics.headline: connected opening into a new directive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not restart cold; it carries the prior prayer command forward while opening a distinct night-vigil directive.
topics.reason: The QAC row identifies the opening connector as resumptive, and the surrounding rows link it to the prior prayer-command sequence.

topics.headline: one-letter boundary compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears continuation before the night frame appears, so the transition feels swift and attached.
topics.reason: The bound proclitic form opens the ayah before the temporal phrase, making continuation the first signal.

topics.headline: circumstantial closeness beside resumption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can keep a felt closeness of circumstance, while the local grammar still makes resumption and coordination the main force.
topics.reason: The source proposes circumstantial pressure; QAC specifically marks resumptive force, so the topic survives only as proximity rather than the controlling parse.

words.gloss_range: partitive-temporal preposition selecting a portion from the known night as the frame for the vigil
words.prose: The preposition {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) builds moderation into the command: it selects a portion from the night, not the whole night. Because the selected-time phrase comes before the imperative, time becomes a usable devotional resource before the action is named. A backward link to the prior prayer command remains a boundary effect, but the local attachment points forward to the vigil. The same night-portion-into-worship-command pattern has a concrete parallel (20:130), and the short preposition pulls the genitive night noun into one selected-time unit.

topics.headline: partitive selection from the night
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command selects from the night rather than consuming the whole night.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both make the preposition govern the night noun as a partitive temporal phrase.

topics.headline: fronted time before action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees time become the frame and resource for action before the imperative arrives.
topics.reason: The phrase headed by the preposition precedes the imperative and is immediately followed by the hinge particle.

topics.headline: boundary-sensitive scope, locally attached forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense the boundary with the prior prayer command, while the local syntax attaches the phrase to the night-vigil imperative.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row proposes a backward reach, but attachment evidence strongly licenses the local command as the head.

topics.headline: night portion plus worship command pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that selected night-time followed by worship command has a concrete parallel (20:130).
topics.reason: The row gives a specific parallel where a night portion leads into worship command language (20:130).

topics.headline: short preposition forces genitive dependency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small preposition is not meaningful alone; it pulls the night noun into a single selected-time unit.
topics.reason: The governed genitive noun supplies the temporal whole from which the portion is selected.

words.gloss_range: the known night as a bounded domain selected for vigil; actual darkness and concealment remain part of the local force
words.prose: In {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}), the night is a known bounded field from which a portion is selected. Its darkness matters: the command is placed in a concealed space where wakefulness has to be chosen. The word also carries formal depth from a minority derivational analysis, though the local sense remains the ordinary night-domain. Across the boundary, night changes role from the endpoint of prayer timing (17:78) to the resource for vigil (17:79), and the wider Surah 17 thread makes night recur as journey (17:1), sign (17:12), boundary (17:78), and vigil-space (17:79). The night-to-raising pattern reverses ordinary night sleep and divine raising (6:60): here voluntary night-waking precedes promised elevation.
words.root_gloss_range: root range for night, darkness, and concealment; local grammar selects the known night-domain rather than an abstract metaphor alone

topics.headline: definite genitive night as selected domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a known, bounded night-domain from which the vigil portion is taken.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive after the partitive preposition, preserving a bounded part-whole relation.

topics.headline: darkness as withdrawal-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that night is not only clock-time; darkness and concealment make it the fitting space for deliberate wakefulness.
topics.reason: The lexical rows connect night with darkness and concealment, and the local command turns that field into vigil-space.

topics.headline: minor derivational dispute without sense replacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the night-word has formal depth, while the local sense remains the ordinary night-domain.
topics.reason: The minority derivation matters formally but does not replace the local temporal-concealment sense.

topics.headline: surah-local night thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices night recurring as journey, sign, boundary, and now vigil-space inside Surah 17 (17:1; 17:12; 17:78; 17:79).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete Surah 17 references where the night field changes function across the surah.

Its grammar matters: it is an adjective of the station, so praisedness belongs to the promised position, not to a separate object, and its indefiniteness keeps the praise-quality open-ended with the station. As a passive participle, it makes the station receive recognized praise for volitional merit rather than self-generated praise. The praise-root resonance reaches the addressee’s name-field without renaming him, reflects wider praise-field references without equating roles (64:6; 11:73), and points forward to the surah’s praise closure (17:111). The repeated -an cadence across surplus, station, and praise and the paired m-openings make the closing pair sound sealed, while the rare passive-participle form makes a common praise root exceptional here.
